profile.headline: Builder and Educator
profile.summary: Mission-driven team builder with a knack for fostering growth, elevating standards, and a history of delivering critical projects on short timelines with high reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Leveraging latest LLMs and related tooling to start an initiative to improve large-scale code migrations.

positions.title: Chief Architect
positions.description:
Owned the charter to build a platform that reliably scales to millions of connections and hundreds of integrations while incurring industry's lowest developmental and operational costs.

In practice, besides getting my hands dirty with actual technical IC work, this translated to: driving the roadmap, reviewing friction logs, design docs, and PRs; shepherding technical discussions and documenting best practices; dogfooding our platform and writing my own friction logs; and fiendishly adding safety primitives to our build pipeline.

positions.title: CEO and Co-Founder
positions.description:
Herald [was] an app for teams to collect, analyze, and collaborate on user feedback.

Seed stage company funded by YCombinator and other angel investors. Grew the company from ideation stage to 35 paying customers.

positions.title: Tech Lead Manager, Observability + SRE
positions.description:
Part of the founding Uber SRE leadership team. 

On a mission to keep Uber up 24/7 with 4 9s or reliability - led the Blackbox project from ideation to acceptance as a critical pillar of Uber reliability. 

Blackbox provided a platform for product teams to test disruptions to business-critical flows, helping catch major outages with a negligible false-positive rate. Blackbox was the first and only multi-cloud app deployed at Uber for many years.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
I joined VMware as part of the Log Insight acquisition (from Pattern Insight).  

I led the efforts to improve end-to-end performance and responsiveness of Log Insight. 

Contributed many user-perceivable performance gains by leveraging techniques such as: smaller work quanta, subquery caching, query precomputation, index term reduction, etc.

Log Insight was 6x as fast the market leader in log analysis products.
